evidence_commit_policy: The following commit changes only this evidence file. The 14 gates ran before the implementation commit; their tested source hashes were checked against the committed blobs. No test rerun at the evidence-only commit is claimed. An external handoff receipt binds the final HEAD without a self-referential commit hash.
decisions: Preserve immutable v0.2 core semantics, hashes and CLI exit codes, including the separately tracked v0.3 overflow issue.
MCP isError only for rejected or file_unreadable; flags and insufficient_data are completed checks.

Require host-configured SENTILAB_RESULTCHECK_DIR; resolve paths under it and validate opened descriptor containment via Linux procfs before any read. Missing/invalid configuration and outside/missing paths return the same hash-free file_unreadable error.
Retain bounded regular-file intake, 16 MiB file cap, 1 MiB pre-parse cap, 10-second MCP worker deadline, cancellation and kill/drain/reap from the P2 correction.

Preserve ordinary Windows CLI intake with O_RDONLY plus O_BINARY, O_NOFOLLOW and O_NONBLOCK only where each exists. Keep fstat immediately after open, size/mtime/ctime checks and bounded reads unchanged.
Catch exceptions around CLI check_file only, returning the same file_unreadable receipt and exit 2 for all intake failures; exit 1 remains reserved for completed flagged/insufficient-data checks.

os_scope.tested: Linux with Python 3.12.3. Four new CLI subprocess tests simulate Windows by replacing only the core OS dependency, removing O_NONBLOCK/O_NOFOLLOW, providing O_BINARY and translating CRLF unless binary mode is selected.
os_scope.binary_proof: Stable []\r\n delivers 4 bytes and the exact native CLI rejected receipt, with exit 2 and empty stderr. Invalid JSON with CRLF also matches the native raw-byte hash.
os_scope.failure_proof: Native and simulated Windows nonregular pipe descriptors are closed without any read; injected OSError and AttributeError at open/fstat/read/close produce structured exit 2 with empty stderr.
os_scope.ordinary_cli: No procfs dependency. O_NOFOLLOW rejects final-component symlinks where supported; platforms without it do not claim that protection. Without O_NONBLOCK, no nonblocking-open guarantee is claimed for special paths before a descriptor is obtained.
os_scope.restricted_intake: MCP and CLI --root retain the Linux /proc/self/fd requirement and fail closed if descriptor resolution is unavailable. Configured in-root symlinks still resolve before open.
os_scope.not_run: Native Windows execution was not run in this Linux box.
